name: Deore XT front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 112 g for the normal-band FD-M730 front derailleur. The catalogue identifies a single normal band fitting 28.0–28.6 mm; this is not the separate 31.8 mm EC endless-clamp version. The weighed AL/HS chain-guide option is not specified.

technical_document.title: Shimano FD-M730 manufacturer exploded view: model identification, series and replacement parts
